title: Mitsuru and Yukari by the river

cues.text: On a riverbank below wooden terraces, Yukari walks away from Mitsuru.
Mitsuru holds her cheek. People stroll past.
Yukari walks off along the path.
Mitsuru stays, a hand on her hip.
Her Persona appears, an armored woman with a crown and blades for arms.
It becomes a masked woman with spiked wings and a wide skirt.
A long whip of bone hangs from her hand.
Back on the path, sparks sink into Mitsuru's chest.
She stands still as people pass.
